welcomedescription: Thank you for using EvntTrackr! I am putting my heart and soul into building an app that reflects who you are as much as it reflects my passion. The app is still in the testing phase: your feedback is essential to improving it! Please feel free to share your thoughts with me via the “About” page. Enjoy exploring!
alwaysimproving: EvntTrackr keeps improving and bringing new ways to enjoy your events. Don't hesitate to share your feedback via the About page 💪
